about: The Deep Wilderness Dungeon (Wilderness step W6.1): its hill giants, chaos dwarves, shadow spiders, fire giants and monks of Zamorak where the OSRS Wiki's locations maps pin them (read 2026-11-15). Their wander ranges are guessed until recorded (the monks stand).
